title: Historic Charleston Walking Tour: Rainbow Row, Churches, and More
includes: A visual tour of Fort Sumter
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The pace of our walking tour is leisurely
Please arrive 15 minutes before the start of the tour.
Operates in all weather conditions, dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Tour where carriages and motorcoaches are not allowed as you take a fascinating stroll with stories and traditions revealing Charleston’s rich history and colorful past. This two hour tour through America’s most charming historical district is sure to be the highlight of your visit.
